projects.name: Medical College of Wisconsin Student Housing
projects.summary: The Medical College of Wisconsin is constructing its first-ever student housing, a $70 million, four-story complex comprising 266 units. This project aims to provide more affordable housing options on the campus.

projects.name: Carmen Southgate Campus
projects.summary: Carmen Schools has unveiled its new $55 million Southgate Campus, a three-story school featuring a STEAM lab, a large gym, and common areas. The new campus is scheduled to open later this month.

projects.name: Concordia University Wisconsin School of Nursing Expansion
projects.summary: Concordia University Wisconsin is investing in a major expansion of its School of Nursing facilities to address growing shortages in nursing and healthcare professionals. This initiative aims to strengthen the region's healthcare workforce pipeline.

projects.name: The Harvest at Pabst Farms
projects.scale: Mixed-use combining housing, employment, retail, hospitality, recreation, open space
projects.summary: The Harvest at Pabst Farms is a large mixed-use master-planned community in Oconomowoc, designed to integrate housing, employment, retail, hospitality, recreation, and open spaces. Developed by Cobalt Partners, the project aims to support regional growth by addressing various community needs.

projects.name: Oak Creek Affordable Housing Subdivision
projects.summary: Milwaukee County is pushing for federal funding to develop a new affordable housing subdivision in Oak Creek, aligning with County Executive David Crowley's broader strategy for housing initiatives.

projects.name: Teutonia Avenue Lounge and Restaurant
projects.location: Northside Shopping Center, Teutonia Avenue, Milwaukee, WI
projects.summary: A proposal for a new lounge and restaurant on Teutonia Avenue within a Northside Shopping Center is seeking city approval. The venue aims to offer brunch, live music, and cater to a 30-plus crowd.

projects.name: Seeds of Health High School Expansion
projects.summary: Seeds of Health announced plans to close one of its high schools while expanding another, indicating significant changes to its educational facilities within Milwaukee Public Schools' partner network.

projects.name: Trap Kitchen Soul Food Restaurant
projects.location: W. Becher St., Near South Side, Milwaukee, WI
projects.summary: A new soul food restaurant named Trap Kitchen is planned for a building on W. Becher Street in Milwaukee's Near South Side. The project involves transforming a space previously known for illegal after-hours parties into a legitimate dining establishment.

projects.name: Milwaukee County Courthouse Project
projects.summary: An $897 million Milwaukee County Courthouse project has hit a major roadblock after a county committee voted to block a referendum for its funding from appearing on the November ballot, potentially halting the project indefinitely.

projects.name: Milwaukee County Courthouse Project
projects.summary: A proposed $897 million project for the Milwaukee County Courthouse is facing political challenges, with the finance chair attempting to block a public referendum that would allow the project to move forward. This significant public undertaking is currently in a critical public approval phase.

projects.name: Amani Homeownership TIF
projects.summary: A proposed Tax Incremental Financing (TIF) district in Milwaukee's Amani neighborhood aims to spur the development of 95 new single-family homes. This initiative is designed to expand homeownership opportunities and is part of the Community Development Alliance's ongoing housing pipeline efforts.

projects.name: Former Wausau Equipment Plant Conversion to Self-Storage
projects.location: New Berlin Industrial Park, New Berlin, WI
projects.summary: An affiliate of Cedarburg Storage Company LLC has acquired the former Wausau Equipment plant and headquarters in New Berlin. The site, vacated by Wausau Equipment, is expected to be redeveloped and converted into a new self-storage facility.

projects.name: Kinship Community Food Center Expansion
projects.summary: Kinship Community Food Center held a groundbreaking for its $18 million, 28,000 sqft new facility in Milwaukee's Harambee neighborhood. This expansion aims to significantly increase food access, workforce development, and support services for the community.

projects.name: Bay View Affordable Housing
projects.summary: A controversial $33 million, 100-unit affordable apartment complex in Milwaukee's Bay View neighborhood received unanimous approval and a subsidy from the Common Council. This project aims to bring new affordable housing options to the area.

projects.name: Fox Communities Credit Union - Oconomowoc Branch
projects.summary: Fox Communities Credit Union filed plans with Oconomowoc's Plan Commission to build a new branch location at 1283 Olympia Fields Drive. This proposed facility would mark the credit union's second branch in southeastern Wisconsin.

projects.name: Bay View Site Development
projects.summary: The City of Milwaukee is restarting its efforts to develop a long-vacant site in Bay View. A conceptual plan has been proposed for a 14-story tower with lake views, aiming to bring significant development to the prominent location.

projects.name: Bay View Affordable Development
projects.summary: An affordable housing development located in Bay View has received a crucial municipal approval, despite some opposition. This significant milestone allows the project to move forward in the development process.

projects.name: Dunkin' (Wauwatosa)
projects.summary: A new Dunkin' location is proposed for a former Starbucks site at 151 N. Mayfair Road in Wauwatosa. A conditional use permit application has been filed with the city's Plan Commission for the renovation of the existing commercial building.

projects.name: New Apartment Building for Walker’s Point
projects.summary: A new apartment building is planned for the Walker's Point neighborhood in Milwaukee, which will replace a surface parking lot. This development aims to add new housing options to the area.

projects.name: Austin Commons
projects.summary: The Milwaukee Common Council has advanced partial funding for Austin Commons, a delayed affordable housing development located in the Bay View neighborhood. This critical funding decision moves the project forward to provide much-needed affordable housing.

projects.name: Northwestern Mutual’s downtown headquarters campus reconstruction
projects.summary: Northwestern Mutual is undertaking a substantial $500 million reconstruction project at its downtown Milwaukee headquarters campus. This major renovation is one of the significant economic development initiatives shaping southeastern Wisconsin.

projects.name: 100 East redevelopment
projects.summary: The planned 100 East redevelopment is noted as a significant economic development project located in downtown Milwaukee. This project is anticipated to contribute to the future growth and transformation of southeastern Wisconsin.

projects.name: Missing Middle Housing Development
projects.summary: Milwaukee County is seeking proposals from developers to build affordable townhomes on vacant land at S. 6th Street, aiming to provide 'missing middle' housing options on the South Side.

projects.name: Microsoft Data Center Campus
projects.status: Construction completed (first center), Construction started (second center), Approved (up to 15 centers)
projects.summary: Microsoft has completed construction of its first data center in Mount Pleasant and has commenced building a second. The Village Board previously approved plans that allow for the construction of up to 15 data centers on the site.

projects.name: Mitchell Park Domes Redevelopment Project
projects.summary: The redevelopment project for the Mitchell Park Domes is gaining strong donor support, with naming rights already awarded for the lobby and the Little Sprouts Dome, indicating ongoing progress and public engagement.

projects.name: Escapology Locations
projects.location: Historic Third Ward, Milwaukee, WI; Brookfield, WI
projects.summary: Escapology, an escape room adventure business, has announced plans to open two new Wisconsin locations. These will be situated in Milwaukee's Historic Third Ward and in Brookfield, expanding its presence in the state.

projects.name: Amazon Logistics Facility
projects.summary: Amazon, through its subsidiary Amazon.com Services LLC, has acquired a 57-acre site in Sheboygan for $2 million. The company previously announced its intentions to construct a new logistics facility on the purchased land.

projects.name: The Gund Company Expansion
projects.summary: The Gund Company, a manufacturer of composite materials, is planning a significant 110,000-square-foot expansion to its current 65,000-square-foot facility located at 809 Philip Dr. in Waukesha.

projects.name: Luxury Hotel Conversion (Former Auto Dealership)
projects.summary: A luxury hotel, developed through the conversion of a 1920s auto dealership, has filed for its opening in Downtown Milwaukee, indicating it will soon welcome its first guests.

projects.name: Downer Theatre Renovation
projects.summary: Milwaukee Film has launched an $8 million capital campaign to fund the renovation of the historic Downer Theatre, a project announced after the organization purchased the venue for $1.55 million.

projects.name: 4448-4450 N. Oakland Ave. Affordable Housing Project
projects.summary: The Village of Shorewood has approved plans by Spoerl Commercial LLC for a 19-unit affordable housing project at 4448-4450 N. Oakland Ave., on the site of a former municipal parking lot.

projects.name: Storage Five Self-Storage Facility
projects.summary: Storage Five has filed plans with the city of West Allis to renovate and expand an existing 133,532-square-foot building into a multi-story, climate-controlled self-storage facility, offering over 884 units.

projects.name: Bay View Piggly Wiggly Renovation
projects.summary: The Piggly Wiggly grocery store in Bay View has completed a multimillion-dollar renovation, featuring aesthetic updates, a revised store layout, and an expanded inventory. This project enhances the shopping experience and revitalizes the local community grocery store.

projects.name: Dulce Diabla New Location
projects.scale: Bar, dance club, and sit-down dining
projects.summary: Dulce Diabla announced plans to establish a new location in Milwaukee's Muskego Way neighborhood, which will feature a bar, dance club, and sit-down dining. This project aims to create a new entertainment and culinary venue on the city's south side.

projects.name: Multiple Affordable Housing Projects
projects.summary: State tax credits have been approved for eight distinct projects across Milwaukee, totaling 709 new affordable apartments. These developments are slated for various neighborhoods, from Downtown to the central city, aiming to expand affordable housing options.

projects.name: Kenosha Innovation Neighborhood (KIN)
projects.summary: The Kenosha Innovation Neighborhood (KIN), a significant master-plan development, announced a strategic partnership with the Wisconsin Women’s Business Initiative Corporation (WWBIC). This collaboration strengthens KIN's mission to serve as a regional hub for entrepreneurs and small businesses, marking a further step in its development.

projects.name: Unnamed Housing and Entertainment Proposal
projects.summary: A proposal for a new housing and entertainment development, replacing a vacant building and a park, has been selected and now awaits final approval from the Milwaukee Common Council.

projects.name: McGovern Park Senior Center
projects.summary: Milwaukee County has approved funding for the design plan of a new senior center at McGovern Park. The project's future construction funding remains a question.

projects.name: Whitefish Bay Affordable Housing Development
projects.summary: A new 17-unit affordable housing development in Whitefish Bay has opened, receiving over 350 applications from prospective tenants, indicating high demand.

projects.name: Coventry Commons
projects.scale: Mixed-use with retail, commercial, multi-family residential, indoor self-storage. Repurposing 60,000 sqft vacant building.
projects.summary: Cobalt Partners is proposing Coventry Commons, a new mixed-use development district at 6800 N. Port Washington Road in Glendale. The project includes retail, commercial, multi-family residential, indoor self-storage, and will repurpose a 60,000-square-foot vacant building.

projects.name: Clock Tower Farms
projects.summary: An indoor farm named Clock Tower Farms is being established within Rockwell Automation's Milwaukee headquarters. It plans to be operational later this year and will supply fresh produce to Feeding America, representing a significant new commercial use within an existing building.

projects.name: Walker Square Park Improvements
projects.summary: Milwaukee County Parks is planning new projects and improvements for Walker Square Park on the city's south side. Construction is slated to begin in 2027, indicating a public works project involving significant physical changes to the park.

projects.name: Former Walmart Redevelopment
projects.scale: Self storage, data center, library (commercial scale)
projects.summary: A former Walmart building in Milwaukee is planned for redevelopment to include new self-storage and data center facilities. These new commercial uses will accompany a planned new library project, indicating a significant transformation of the site.

projects.name: Soonja's Seoul Pocha
projects.summary: Soonja's Seoul Pocha, a new Korean pub and restaurant, is proposed for National Avenue in Milwaukee. The establishment aims to introduce Korean pub culture, traditional food, and trendy cocktails to the city.

projects.name: Facebook-Meta Data Center
projects.summary: Regulators have approved electric rates for the Facebook-Meta data center located in Beaver Dam, WI. This milestone indicates the large-scale commercial project is progressing, despite criticisms regarding transparency during the approval process.

projects.name: Jefferson County Industrial Development (Wangard)
projects.summary: Wangard Partners is acquiring a 17-acre site in Jefferson, adjacent to the Food & Beverage Innovation Campus, to develop a build-to-suit facility exceeding 200,000 square feet. The Wauwatosa-based developer is actively seeking a single user for this large industrial/commercial project.

projects.name: Forensic Science and Protective Medicine Facility
projects.summary: The State of Wisconsin and Milwaukee County have purchased the new 212,000-square-foot Forensic Science and Protective Medicine Facility in Wauwatosa for over $219 million. This four-story building, which broke ground nearly three years ago, will serve as the Milwaukee Crime Lab and the county's new Medical Examiner’s Office.

projects.name: St. Augustine Preparatory Academy North Campus
projects.summary: St. Augustine Preparatory Academy is preparing to launch a new K4-12 Christian north campus in Milwaukee for the upcoming school year. The school recently raised over $2.5 million at its annual gala to support this significant educational expansion.

projects.name: Bank of America South Side Branch
projects.summary: Bank of America plans to replace an existing Dollar Tree store on Milwaukee's South Side with a new branch. This marks the nation's second-largest bank's entry into the Milwaukee market at several locations, indicating significant commercial expansion.

projects.name: Kingdom Faith Senior Housing Complex
projects.scale: 181 units · senior apartments · memory care center · church expansion
projects.summary: Kingdom Faith Church is planning a major ground-up development near Milwaukee's city border. The complex will feature 181 senior apartment units, a memory care center, and an expanded church facility, addressing local senior housing and community needs.

projects.name: Milwaukee Affordable Housing Conversion Proposal
projects.summary: A proposal has been submitted to the Milwaukee City Council to convert two existing 'luxury' residential complexes into affordable housing units. This major renovation project requires city approval and is currently undergoing public review, with the Council reportedly poised to reject it.
